en.t: Thinking of the past, I cannot help but sigh with sorrow.

units.source_text: 只有访晤故人，方得安慰寸心。

en.t: Only by visiting old friends can I find a little comfort for my heart.

units.source_text: 惟旧恨虽消，而新愁又生。

en.t: Yet although old grievances have faded, new sorrows arise again.
It is the way of the world for people to flock to power and influence.

units.source_text: 因此可共话往昔之人，寥若晨星。

en.t: For that reason, people with whom one can speak of the old days are as rare as stars at dawn.

units.source_text: 何况冷冷清清，无可消遣，怎生是好？”

en.t: Besides, it is so lonely and quiet here, with nothing to pass the time; what am I to do?"

units.source_text: 女御听了这番话，深感世变无常，人生多苦，那沉思冥想的神色异常悲哀。

en.t: When the lady heard these words, she deeply felt the impermanence of the world and the many sorrows of life, and her pensive expression was exceedingly sad.

units.source_text: 大约是人品优越之故吧，样子特别可怜。

en.t: Perhaps because of her exceptional character, she looked especially pitiful.
